keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Granit Xhaka (Sunderland).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Sunderland. Jules Ahoka replaces Granit Xhaka because of an injury.
Jules Ahoka (Sunderland) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Levi Colwill (Chelsea) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Sunderland 1, Chelsea 0. Enzo Le Fée (Sunderland) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
First Half ends, Sunderland 1, Chelsea 0.
Substitution, Chelsea. Estêvão replaces Levi Colwill.
Thomas Meunier (Sunderland) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match (Chelsea).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) is shown the yellow card.
Pedro Neto (Chelsea) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Chelsea. Danny Welbeck replaces Pedro Neto.
Substitution, Chelsea. Malo Gusto replaces Marco Palestra.
Substitution, Sunderland. Wilson Isidor replaces Brian Brobbey.
Moisés Caicedo (Chelsea) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Chelsea. Geovany Quenda replaces Pep Chavarría.
Substitution, Chelsea. Emmanuel Emegha replaces Jordan Henderson.
Substitution, Sunderland. Nilson Angulo replaces Chemsdine Talbi.
Substitution, Sunderland. Chris Rigg replaces Enzo Le Fée.
Luke O'Nien (Sunderland) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) is shown the yellow card.
Nilson Angulo (Sunderland) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
